Bring in your entries
Import from Google Drive or a link, or paste text by hand. Either way you can fix up titles and line breaks afterward.
Paste a link to a web page, a PDF, a Google Doc, or a Google Drive folder with your entries. Bookbug works out the titles, sections, stanzas, bold, italics and indents — you can fix anything afterward. A folder brings in every PDF, Google Doc and text file in it, in order by file name. Anything in Drive needs to be shared as “Anyone with the link”; otherwise use Import from Google Drive to pick it yourself.
Paste plain text below. Mark each entry’s title by starting its line with ### — this is exactly what a Google Docs Heading paragraph turns into when brought in from Drive, so anything you'd import will already match. Separate entries with a blank line. Blank lines inside an entry become stanza breaks.
